▼// Availability
Nov. 5, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance


▼// Event Content Update Time
Nov. 12, 2026 at 12:00 (server time)


▼// [Secret Sanctuary] Availability
Nov. 5, 2026 at 12:00 – Dec. 2, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)


▼// Event Rewards
· Complete mission goals during the event to earn [Portrait: Silverblade Medal], [Portrait Frame: Contingency Respondent], and [Vitrified Indigo] rewards.
· Spend [Vitrified Indigo] at the [Secret Sanctuary] to exchange for great rewards, including [Oroberyls], [Sticker: Contingency Resolved], and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate II].


▼// Participation Criteria
· Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process II: Paving the Way]
· Authority Level ≥ 30


▼// Event Details
· [Contingency Contract] is a high-difficulty free challenge mode, where you can freely combine Test Criteria of varying difficulties to complete combat challenges.
· Combat comprises a total of 3 waves. Defeat all enemies to beat the challenge. If you fail the challenge, the challenge must be re-attempted from the beginning.
· Test Criteria come in three difficulty levels: 1/2/3. Your Total Test Criteria is the sum of the difficulty levels of all selected Test Criteria. As you achieve higher Total Test Criteria records, more Criteria Sets in different sections will unlock.
· Some Test Criteria are [Locked Criteria]. Select the specified [Key Criteria] to unlock them.
· After event launch, new Test Criteria will be added on day 8. However, they cannot be selected if their Criteria Set is still locked.
· New cycle missions will be added every 3 days (updated at 04:00 server time) during the event. There are 7 cycle missions in total, and all challenges and missions will remain available until the event ends.
· During the event, meet specified conditions to obtain the event-exclusive engraved medal.


▼// [Sanctuary Rating] Display System
· Successfully completing a challenge with a Total Test Criteria of at least 1 activates the event-exclusive [Sanctuary Rating], which can be displayed on your Friends screen.
· [Sanctuary Rating] will only be active for the duration of this event.


▼// Important Notes
· All Contract Missions and combat challenges will close when the event ends.
· After the event ends, [Secret Sanctuary] will remain open for reward exchange until Dec. 2, 2026 at 04:00 (server time). Once [Secret Sanctuary] closes, all unused [Vitrified Indigo] will be cleared.


※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].

data.html:
Dear Endministrator:
We will adjust the schedules for certain events in the [Sanctuary of Ink] version. All related content and rewards will remain unchanged. These adjustments will take effect after the quick update on Nov. 5, 2026. Details are as follows:

▼// Adjustment Details
■ The end time of the [Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves] Fun & Games Event will be adjusted as follows:
Asia Server: Nov. 25, 2026 at 06:00 (server time)
Americas / Europe Server: Nov. 24, 2026 at 17:00 (server time)

■ The event period for the [Sanity Supply] Limited-Time Event will be adjusted as follows:
Asia Server: Nov. 18, 2026 at 04:00 – Nov. 25, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)
Americas / Europe Server: Nov. 18, 2026 at 04:00 – Nov. 24, 2026 at 17:00 (server time)

■ The end time for exchanges in the [Secret Sanctuary] of [Contingency Contract: Indigo Experimental Operation] will be adjusted to Dec. 2, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

▼// Additional Notes
The content and rewards for other events and gameplay modes (such as the [Umbral Monument - Murmurs of the Deep Forest] series and [Delver of the Cryptic - Fade Beyond the Painting]) will remain unchanged.

Thank you for your continued understanding and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8
※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5

· Distribution Period: Oct. 28, 2026 at 10:30 (UTC+8) – Before the next version update and maintenance
· Eligibility: Endministrators who registered and created a character before the quick update on Nov. 5, 2026
· Note: Compensation will be sent via in-game mail. The mail will expire at the next version update and maintenance, so please claim it in time.
